# py2mcp

> Quick MCP server creation from Python functions


## Pages

- [py2mcp](index.html.md): Quick MCP (Model Context Protocol) server creation from Python functions.

- [py2mcp](_autosummary/py2mcp.html.md): py2mcp: Quick MCP server creation from Python functions.
- [py2mcp.base](_autosummary/py2mcp.base.html.md): Private helpers shared by the builders in [`py2mcp.main`](py2mcp.main.html.md#module-py2mcp.main).
- [py2mcp.http](_autosummary/py2mcp.http.html.md): Serve a py2mcp `FastMCP` server over Streamable HTTP with optional OAuth 2.1.
- [py2mcp.main](_autosummary/py2mcp.main.html.md): Build a `FastMCP` server from Python functions, reference strings, or a store.
- [py2mcp.serve](_autosummary/py2mcp.serve.html.md): Serve a py2mcp `FastMCP` server over stdio, as a packaged integration launches it.
- [py2mcp.trans](_autosummary/py2mcp.trans.html.md): Input transformation for py2mcp tools: convert arguments before a function runs.
- [py2mcp.util](_autosummary/py2mcp.util.html.md): Resolve object references and turn a mapping into CRUD functions.
